FFmpeg 7.0.2 static ARMHF build

Binary build: https://www.johnvansickle.com/ffmpeg/
Archive: https://johnvansickle.com/ffmpeg/releases/ffmpeg-release-armhf-static.tar.xz
Archive MD5: bd0c3d4821a5ddce1a4339cd00031e38
SHA-256 (included ffmpeg binary): 0afba4a11110e6e402053e0fc14c33a7eb207d7a588688ae87dba471a0f06c71
FFmpeg source: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-7.0.2.tar.xz
Builder release source index: https://johnvansickle.com/ffmpeg/release-source/

The included ffmpeg binary is used only to demux and remux H.264/AAC DASH
tracks. PocketStream does not transcode video with it. See GPLv3.txt and
BUILD-INFO.txt in this directory for license and build details.
